perspective:
Arthur’s accessible information:

- He knows he is Arthur Chung, a plumber with a doctorate, and that Teresa Ortega is a colleague he often collaborates with on community service projects.
- During this project, he observes Teresa working very hard and appearing overwhelmed. He feels concerned for her well-being and decides to offer help.
- He tells Teresa he noticed she seems overwhelmed and asks if he can help. Teresa says she thinks she can manage but has a lot to do. He urges self-care and suggests they work faster together. Teresa accepts help organizing medical supplies. They start.
- Arthur believes Teresa is hesitant because she wants to prove she can do it herself. He admires that and wants to reassure her that accepting help does not mean she is incapable.
- He tells her this. Teresa says she appreciates it and wants to show she can do it by herself. Arthur says teamwork can be more effective and it is not about proving anything. Teresa agrees she needs reminding. Arthur says they are in this together and he supports her.
- Later, Arthur believes Teresa is still struggling and feels frustrated that his efforts are not yielding results. He intends to find another way to support her without making her feel inadequate.
- He tells Teresa things are still tough and that she is doing a great job. Teresa says it has been busy and she feels behind. Arthur proposes working together instead of just helping her. Teresa agrees. Arthur says they will tackle it as a team.
- Arthur feels hopeful that working together will ease Teresa’s burden and improve efficiency. He intends to fully commit to the collaborative approach.
- He tells Teresa he is hopeful. Teresa agrees and says it already feels less overwhelming. Arthur says he will handle inventory while she manages patient records, with regular check-ins. Teresa agrees and says she is glad. Arthur says he is too and wants a productive day.
- At the end, Arthur believes their collaboration has strengthened their professional relationship and feels satisfied. He tells Teresa their teamwork paid off. Teresa agrees and says it was a great experience. Arthur suggests continuing this collaborative approach in future projects. Teresa calls it a fantastic idea and says they have proven they can be more efficient and effective as a team. Arthur agrees to keep it up and looks forward to their next project. Teresa thanks him for being supportive.
